# langsmith_sso_settings (Data Source)

Use this data source to read the current organization's LangSmith SSO settings. If the organization has multiple SSO configurations, specify `id` to select one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads the current organization's SSO settings. If the organization has
# multiple SSO configurations, specify `id` to select one.
data "langsmith_sso_settings" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the SSO settings. Optional when the organization has exactly one SSO configuration.

### Read-Only

- `default_workspace_ids` (String) JSON-encoded array of default workspace IDs for SSO-provisioned users.
- `default_workspace_role_id` (String) Default role ID for SSO-provisioned users.
- `metadata_url` (String) The SAML metadata URL.
- `metadata_xml` (String, Sensitive) The SAML metadata XML.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID that owns these SSO settings.
- `provider_id` (String) The SSO provider ID.
